display_name: PAMF 五分支源 U 梯度保护的跨设置实验
scope: F0 Main split, receiver splits 1/2 and 5% labeled; each has seeds 2026092701/02/03. All four conditions have previously exposed target data and are development evaluation.
method: Keep the existing full Tri-SIG-TIME REPL and the fixed F0-developed source-practical five-branch U certificate and .25-to-zero E21–50 taper. Replace only the existing one-sided U/L gradient projection grouping. Instead of lumping branch parameters in other, separately project and cap U gradient against the complete current true L objective within time projection, frequency path and projections, PA path and projections, signature and reference parameter groups. Shared sinc, time trunk other than separately guarded t2, and fusion stay in other. Retain the pre-existing t2 and classifier groups and an other group, max U/L norm ratio 1 and zero U for tiny L unchanged. All existing raw/U losses, selection and head remain; domain parameters not belonging to the deployed encoder stay in original groups. This uses no U labels or target training data.
initialization: Exact same-setting and same-seed original source-only Tri-SIG-TIME scratch E20; own E10+E20, fixed E50/11100 updates. Match physical source IDs/roles, RX/day and checkpoint provenance.
controls: Exact same setting/seed original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
ordinary PL with matching setting/seed and physical test inputs
same-setting/seed existing taper with the original three-group gradient guard
evaluation: Fixed E50, clean and six practical scenes, DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary, each protocol's exact matching frozen caches. All 12 frozen prediction matrices precede independent truth-last scoring. Three-seed matched physical packet comparisons by scenario and TX/RX/day; no leo_weak, no target-driven selection/tuning/reruns.
success: Every setting must separately exceed Tri on three-seed mean clean and six-practical mean and exceed PL in each scene mean; report each seed/scenario and subgroup loss. Universal claim requires each seed/scenario positive versus PL and independent unexposed settings and extra paired seeds.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --branch-guard --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
environment: N607 ordinary account, project Python, immutable Git release and unique run/output root, FP32/TF32 off.
resources: GPU 0–7, no more than two observed or pending processes per GPU including other owners. One owner and real-checkpoint no-query smoke across 12 rows.
stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch and preserves other healthy workers and artifacts. No optional source diagnostics, weak scoring, or target-driven reruns.
expected_artifacts: Twelve same-contract original E20 source-only smoke checks
Own E30/E50 and per-branch gradient conflict/cap counts
Independent three-seed and same-packet raw/DURA analysis per setting
